title: How to Start an AI Automation Agency in 2026 (Step by Step)
promo_conflict: Tutorial built entirely on Base44 Super Agents (likely sponsored)

stated_problem.quote: You message an agent about a home, for example, you hear nothing for hours and then eventually just move on to someone else who replies faster.
stated_problem.speaker: Mikey No Code

idea.name: Niche AI automation agency for real estate brokerages
idea.one_liner: Package three AI agents (speed-to-lead follow-up, inquiry triage/scoring, weekly executive reporting) built in Base44 into a 'Real Estate Growth Suite' sold to brokerages via targeted cold outreach, a Loom demo and a free 15-minute lead-flow audit
idea.customer: real estate brokerages and teams (managing brokers)
idea.offer: done-for-you AI lead response, triage and reporting agents
idea.revenue_model: setup fee ($1,000-5,000) plus monthly retainer ($500-1,500 per office)

key_quotes.quote: Now, what you do need is one expensive, repetitive problem inside a business and a system that fixes it automatically.
So, the cleanest structure for this agency model is an upfront setup fee followed by a monthly retainer.
So, a much easier entry point is really a free 15-minute lead flow and operations audit.

claims.claim: First-client setup fee $1,000-3,000, rising to $3,500-5,000+ with proof
claims.quote: And so for your first few clients, a realistic set of fee sits somewhere between $1,000 and $3,000.
And for real estate teams, the monthly retainer will usually fall between, say, $500 and $1,500 per office or team.
So, for the commercial terms here, the one-time setup and integration fee is $2,500.

claims.claim: Hire a junior operator around $5-10k MRR
claims.quote: Once monthly recurring revenue reaches, say roughly $5,000 to $10,000, well, spending most of your time fixing connections and adjusting prompts is no longer the best use of your time.

acquisition_channels.details: LinkedIn and direct email to managing brokers with problem-solution-result message
lead flow and operations audit as entry point
30-day results used for next clients in same niche

ideas.delivery: Clone tested Base44 agents per client, connect Gmail/Google Sheets/CRM via OAuth, customise prompts, end-to-end test, 7-10 day delivery; retainer covers monitoring and prompt updates; document SOPs before hiring
ideas.other_uk_rules: PECR for cold email to sole-trader agents; UK GDPR data processing agreement when handling client lead data
